title: シーキングザパール登場！

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My name is Seeking the Pearl, and I exist to show dreams to people around the world and save them from despair!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now let me show you my moments of glory, from my consecutive wins in domestic races to my triumph of becoming the first Umamusume from Tracen Academy to win a European G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: First of all, I have to choose whether I should run miles and sprints, or take on the Triple Tiara. If I go with miles and sprints…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The biggest obstacle standing in my way will be Taiki Shuttle! But the stronger my opponent is, the more exciting things get!
